properties.name: state
properties.description:
Whose words: the person's, set to the right on a wash, or the agent's, on
a surface. An agent's reply with working behind it is `agent-folded` (the
working hidden behind "See more ›") or `agent-open` (the working shown
above the reply, "See less" to hide it), each with the green done dot. A
reply still being made is `agent-working` (the pulsing dot, "Working…");
one whose agent ended before replying is `agent-stopped` (the grey dot and
a line saying to write below to pick it up).

properties.name: children
properties.description: The words: paragraphs, and a numbered list when the agent asks.

properties.name: documents
properties.description: The documents that came with it, by name.

properties.name: working
properties.description: What the agent did before it replied: one line each; shown only when open.

properties.name: onToggle
properties.description: The fold button was pressed; the page flips `state` between folded and open.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Working and stopped replies show their working only when this is set.
